title: 第14章 草药的采集第15章 突发的遭遇
content_zh:
将一切处理妥当后，两人走出村庄。
和那男人说的一样，村庄西边有几个相当显眼的小山包，一眼就能分辨出所谓第二高的小山包在什么地方。
远远看去，这些小山包上只有零星几棵树木，大部分地方都被灌木或者杂草霸占，导致看上去光秃秃的。
确定方向后，两人便顺着小道一路朝着目标前进了。
有野外生存经验的凯斯在前带路，柯林紧跟在后面。
“你说这玩意儿值十枚金币？”凯斯不敢置信的看着手里的玻管。
“当然。”
柯林一边吃力地前进一边说：“这可是对所有毒素都有效果的万能药，再卖贵点我也不奇怪。”
“那咱们不去把这卖了？”
“你这想法……”柯林说：“最好先别卖，至少遇到哥布林的时候我们还能喝下去防止中毒。”
“那群小玩意儿的毒素靠自己就能扛，没必要。”
“那更没必要拿自己的命当赌注了，凯斯。”柯林说：“再怎么说，要卖药水也得回去再说了，而且卖的时候肯定会被压价，最后卖不卖得了两个金币还难说呢，你想现在掉头？”
“那肯定还得去搞草药啊，来都来了。”凯斯若有所思地咕哝了两声，“十金币的药水回去就只能卖那么点了？”
“一个拿着药水的穷鬼，谁知道他手里的药是稀释过的还是加了点什么料？这种药水又不能让人尝着试试，就算是卖给识货的草药师，他也不会出高价的，不服你就去找别人。”
“你们这些人类可真够扯淡的。”
“欢迎来到现实世界，半兽人。”柯林说：“你还是多逛逛二手市场吧，要不然买东西的时候被人坑了都不知道。”
“比起学这些莫名其妙的狗屎东西，还是叫你一声方便点。”凯斯说。
“那你得给点工钱。”
“去你的吧。”
两人继续在难走的丘陵间前进，地上到处都是凹凸不平的岩石，走起来相当费劲，所幸从海面上刮来的海风并不燥热，也不算太过难受。

随着时间的流逝，偶尔能瞧见的那些试图找些草药的难民和牧羊人也都看不见了。
这也算是好事，虽然他们看见凯斯后都会远远的避开，但柯林还真担心有人上来找麻烦。
“停下。”
“怎么了？”忙着赶路的柯林被凯斯这一声吓了一跳，连忙扶住腰间的剑柄。
凯斯低头看着前方的地面说：“这里有点怪。”
柯林也低头看去。
两人站在一块凸起的岩石上，岩石边缘有条稍微平整一些的、通往岩石下方的小道。
下去一看，石头下面居然有个小洞穴。
这洞穴的位置可以说相当隐蔽了，离远了压根看不见。或者说，在这种丘陵地带本身就很难看见藏在岩缝间的东西。
两人走进去一看，发现这里有个明显的生火点，角落里也有些奇形怪状的石头和骨头碎渣，还能看见几块垫在地上的、散发着恶臭的兽皮。
“不会错的，是哥布林据点。”凯斯蹲下捡起了块骨渣，“快到冬天了，这群小东西应该回老家了。”
“这倒是个好消息。”柯林点了点头。
“哥布林这种生物除了主要巢穴外，还会在巢穴周围设立收集资源的小据点，据点内的哥布林每隔一段时间就会回到主巢上缴资源，这些野外据点也就会空下来。”
凯斯接着说：“咱可不想遇到那些小东西，他们很麻烦，而且大一点的哥布林部落都会养座狼，碰上了就意味着很难逃走了。”
“那我们进来了不是很危险？狼会闻到气味。”
“作为一个人类，你很聪明了。”
凯斯看了看周围：“不过这个据点里没有能养座狼的地方，也没瞧见座狼屎，所以咱们在这周围应该不会遇上这种麻烦，当然，还是得小心。”
说完，两人走出洞穴继续前进。
又走了大概半小时，柯林突然在一道岩缝内发现了个奇怪的植物。
这东西长得像是个风滚草，淡黄色的茎叶密集的交织在一起，隐约能看见上面如和玫瑰差不多的小刺，在海风的吹拂下，这株小草纹丝不动。
content_en:
After everything was settled, the two walked out of the village.
Just as the man said, there are several quite conspicuous hills on the west side of the village. You can tell where the so-called second-highest hill is at a glance.
From a distance, there are only a few scattered trees on these hills, and most of the places are occupied by shrubs or weeds, making them look bare.
After determining the direction, the two of them followed the trail towards their goal.
Keith, who had experience in wilderness survival, led the way, followed closely by Colin.
"You said this thing is worth ten gold coins?" Case looked at the glass tube in his hand in disbelief.
"Of course."
Colin said as he trudged forward: "This is a panacea that is effective against all toxins. I wouldn't be surprised if it is more expensive."
"Then why don't we go and sell this?"
"What do you think..." Colin said: "It's best not to sell it yet. At least we can drink it to prevent poisoning when we encounter goblins."
"You can handle the toxins from those gadgets on your own, so there's no need."
"Then there's no need to gamble with your life, Case." Colin said: "No matter what, if you want to sell the potion, you have to go back and talk about it, and the price will definitely be lowered when you sell it. It's hard to say whether you can sell it for two gold coins in the end. Do you want to turn around now?"
"Then we must have to buy herbal medicine. We've already come here." Keith mumbled thoughtfully, "Can you only sell so much of the ten gold coin potion?"
"A poor man holding a potion, who knows whether the medicine in his hand is diluted or has some added ingredients? This kind of potion cannot be tasted. Even if it is sold to a herbalist who knows the goods, he will not pay a high price. If you are not satisfied, go find someone else."
"You humans are such nonsense."
"Welcome to the real world, half-orc." Colin said, "You'd better visit the second-hand market more often, otherwise you won't even know you've been scammed when you buy something."
"Rather than learning these incomprehensible shit, it's easier to just call you," Case said.
"Then you have to pay me some wages."
"Fuck you."
The two continued to move forward among the hills that were difficult to walk on. The ground was full of uneven rocks and it was quite difficult to walk. Fortunately, the sea breeze blowing from the sea was not too hot or too uncomfortable.
As time passed, the refugees and shepherds who could occasionally be seen trying to find some herbs were no longer visible.
This was a good thing. Although they would stay away from Keith when they saw him, Colin was really worried that someone would come up to cause trouble.
"Stop."
"What's wrong?" Colin, who was busy on his way, was startled by Keith's voice and quickly held onto the hilt of the sword at his waist.
Case looked down at the ground ahead and said, "It's a little weird here."
Colin also looked down.
The two of them were standing on a raised rock. There was a slightly flatter path on the edge of the rock that led to the bottom of the rock.
When I went down and took a look, there was actually a small cave under the stone.
The location of this cave can be said to be quite hidden, and it cannot be seen at all from a distance. In other words, it is difficult to see things hidden in the rock crevices in such hilly areas.
The two walked in and took a look, and found that there was an obvious fire point here, and there were also some strange-shaped stones and bone fragments in the corner. They could also see a few pieces of stinking animal skins on the ground.
"It's unmistakable, it's a Goblin stronghold." Case squatted down and picked up a piece of bone debris. "It's almost winter, and these little guys should go back to their hometown."
"That's good news." Colin nodded.
"In addition to the main nest, goblins will also set up small strongholds around the nest to collect resources. The goblins in the stronghold will return to the main nest to hand over resources every once in a while, and these wild strongholds will become empty."
Case continued: "We don't want to encounter those little ones, they are very troublesome, and the larger goblin tribeThere are wargs in every city, and if you encounter one, it means it will be difficult to escape. "
“Then wouldn’t it be dangerous for us to come in? Wolves can smell. "
"As a human being, you are very smart. "
Case looked around: "But there is no place to raise wargs in this stronghold, and there is no warg excrement, so we should not encounter such trouble around here. Of course, we still have to be careful. "
After saying that, the two walked out of the cave and continued moving forward.
After walking for about half an hour, Colin suddenly discovered a strange plant in a rock crevice.
This thing looks like a tumbleweed, with light yellow stems and leaves densely intertwined, and small thorns similar to roses can be vaguely seen on it. Under the blowing of the sea breeze, this small grass does not move at all.
